request: how many squares can a knight reach from the middle of a chessboard?

beats.intent: An 8 by 8 chessboard with a knight marker on d4
beats.narration: Put a knight on d four, near the middle of the board.
beats.code:
stage.title("Knight moves")
board = VGroup(*[Square(0.6, stroke_width=0, fill_color=(GREY_D if (r + c) % 2 else GREY_B), fill_opacity=1)
                 for r in range(8) for c in range(8)]).arrange_in_grid(rows=8, cols=8, buff=0).move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(board))
stage.add(board)
cell = lambda col, row: board[(7 - row) * 8 + col]
knight = Circle(radius=0.22, color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=1).move_to(cell(3, 3))
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(knight))
stage.add(knight)
stage.label(knight, "N", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: The 8 squares an L-shaped move reaches, lit green
beats.narration: A knight moves two squares one way and one square the other: an L. From here that reaches eight squares.
beats.code:
jumps = [(1, 2), (2, 1), (2, -1), (1, -2), (-1, -2), (-2, -1), (-2, 1), (-1, 2)]
targets = [cell(3 + dc, 3 + dr) for dc, dr in jumps]
stage.play(*[t.animate.set_fill(GREEN, opacity=0.9) for t in targets])
stage.caption("8 moves from d4")

beats.intent: A knight in the corner a1 with only its 2 squares lit
beats.narration: In a corner it is trapped: only two moves. That is why knights belong in the middle.
beats.code:
stage.play(*[t.animate.set_fill(GREY_D if (board.submobjects.index(t) // 8 + board.submobjects.index(t) % 8) % 2 else GREY_B, opacity=1) for t in targets])
stage.play(knight.animate.move_to(cell(0, 0)))
corner = [cell(1, 2), cell(2, 1)]
stage.play(*[t.animate.set_fill(RED, opacity=0.9) for t in corner])
stage.caption("from a corner: only 2")

request: what does 3 to 1 odds mean as a probability?

beats.intent: Four boxes: three marked lose, one marked win
beats.narration: Odds of three to one against mean three ways to lose for every one way to win.
beats.code:
stage.title("Odds and probability")
boxes = VGroup(*[Square(1.2, color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.5, fill_color=(GREEN if k == 3 else RED)) for k in range(4)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2).move_to([0, 0.3, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(b) for b in boxes], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(boxes)
for k, b in enumerate(boxes):
    t = Text("win" if k == 3 else "lose", font_size=26).move_to(b)
    stage.play(FadeIn(t), run_time=0.2)
    stage.add(t)

beats.narration: That is four outcomes in all, one of them a win: a probability of one in four.

beats.intent: Bars of probability for odds 1 to 1, 3 to 1 and 9 to 1: 50%, 25%, 10%
beats.narration: Even odds, one to one, is fifty percent. Nine to one is ten percent.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [50, 25, 10], labels=["1 to 1", "3 to 1", "9 to 1"], color=GREEN)
stage.caption("chance of winning, %")

request: how long does it take to walk 5 km at 4 km an hour?

beats.intent: A number line from 0 to 5 km with a walker dot at 0
beats.narration: The walk is five kilometres. You cover four every hour.
beats.code:
stage.title("Walking time")
nl = draw_number_line(stage, x_range=(0, 5))
walker = Dot(nl.n2p(0), color=YELLOW, radius=0.14)
stage.play(GrowFromCenter(walker))
stage.add(walker)

beats.intent: The walker reaching 4 km after one hour, then the last 1 km
beats.narration: After one hour you are at four kilometres. One kilometre is left: a quarter of an hour's walk.
beats.code:
stage.play(walker.animate.move_to(nl.n2p(4)), run_time=2, rate_func=linear)
hour = mark_point(stage, nl, 4, color=ORANGE, label="1 hour")
stage.play(walker.animate.move_to(nl.n2p(5)), run_time=0.5, rate_func=linear)
stage.caption("the last km: 1/4 hour")

beats.intent: The line beside 5 ÷ 4 = 1.25 h = 1 h 15 min
beats.narration: Distance over speed: five over four is one and a quarter hours, one hour and fifteen minutes.

request: what does the magnetic field around a bar magnet look like?

beats.intent: A bar magnet drawn as a red N half and a blue S half
beats.narration: A bar magnet has a north end and a south end.
beats.code:
stage.title("A magnet's field")
n_half = Rectangle(width=1.2, height=0.6, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([0.6, 0, 0])
s_half = Rectangle(width=1.2, height=0.6, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.9).move_to([-0.6, 0, 0])
stage.play(FadeIn(n_half), FadeIn(s_half))
stage.add(n_half, s_half)
stage.label(n_half, "N", direction=RIGHT, color=RED)
stage.label(s_half, "S", direction=LEFT, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: Arrows of the field all around, pointing out of N and curving round into S
beats.narration: Its field points out of the north end, loops around, and comes back into the south end.
beats.code:
def_field = lambda x, y: (np.array([(x - 1.2), y]) / ((x - 1.2) ** 2 + y ** 2 + 0.3) ** 1.5
                          - np.array([(x + 1.2), y]) / ((x + 1.2) ** 2 + y ** 2 + 0.3) ** 1.5)
draw_vector_field(stage, lambda x, y: tuple(def_field(x, y) / (np.linalg.norm(def_field(x, y)) + 1e-9) * 0.8))
stage.caption("out of N, round, into S")

beats.intent: Two field lines traced as loops from N to S above and below the magnet
beats.narration: Follow the arrows and you trace loops from north round to south, the lines iron filings line up along.
beats.code:
top = ArcBetweenPoints([1.2, 0.2, 0], [-1.2, 0.2, 0], angle=-PI * 0.9, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=5)
bot = ArcBetweenPoints([1.2, -0.2, 0], [-1.2, -0.2, 0], angle=PI * 0.9, color=YELLOW, stroke_width=5)
top2 = top.copy().stretch(2.2, 1, about_point=ORIGIN)
bot2 = bot.copy().stretch(2.2, 1, about_point=ORIGIN)
stage.play(Create(top), Create(bot), Create(top2), Create(bot2))
stage.add(top, bot, top2, bot2)
